plan: Model session state, screen construction, and action interpretation as separate methods.
Validate each action completely before mutating session data.
Inject input/output ports and implement run_once as a single read-handle-display cycle.
mechanisms: A four-field public session dictionary with a clean-session factory.
A copied appointment list and ID lookup set.
A deterministic screen builder that exposes choices only for appointment selection.
Validate-before-commit action handlers that return error screens without mutation.
Constructor-injected action source and screen sink compatible with standard-library unittest fakes.
